# YESPYQ

> Free previous year questions (PYQs), previous year papers (PYP) and NCERT chapter PDFs for India's major competitive and board exams — UPSC, JEE, NEET, SSC CGL, Defence and Class 9–12 Boards. Every question carries the correct answer and a written explanation. Practice online instantly; no signup required to browse.

YESPYQ is a free study resource. Around 20,000+ solved previous year questions are organised by exam, subject, chapter and year, alongside downloadable NCERT and board-syllabus chapter PDFs. A paid "PYQ Pass" (₹149/year) unlocks answers and explanations on the ~90% of questions that are gated; question text and all options are always free to read.

## Practice

- [Home](https://yespyq.com/): Start practice, build a PYQ mock test, or sit a timed real-exam-mode test.
- [All exams](https://yespyq.com/exams/): Hub for UPSC, JEE, NEET, Board, Defence and SSC CGL previous year questions.
- [UPSC PYQs](https://yespyq.com/pyq/): UPSC CSE Prelims previous year questions, subject-wise and year-wise, with answers and explanations.
- [UPSC subjects](https://yespyq.com/subjects/): Subject landing pages — Polity, History, Geography, Economy, Environment, Science & Tech, Current Affairs.

## Exam question banks

- [JEE PYQs](https://yespyq.com/exams/jee/): JEE Main & Advanced previous year questions by subject and chapter.
- [NEET PYQs](https://yespyq.com/exams/neet/): NEET-UG previous year questions by subject and chapter.
- [Board exam PYQs](https://yespyq.com/exams/board/): Class 11 & 12 board previous year questions by subject and chapter.
- [SSC CGL PYQs](https://yespyq.com/exams/ssc-cgl/): SSC Combined Graduate Level previous year questions by subject.
- [Defence PYQs](https://yespyq.com/exams/defence/): Agniveer, AFCAT, Coast Guard and other defence exam previous year questions.

## Free PDFs

- [NCERT PDFs](https://yespyq.com/ncert-pdfs/): Free NCERT chapter PDF downloads for Class 11 and Class 12 — Physics, Chemistry, Maths.
- [Study material PDFs](https://yespyq.com/study-material/): Free board-syllabus chapter PDFs for Class 9–12 across Maths, Science, English, Social Science and more.

## Tools & reading

- [Tools](https://yespyq.com/tools/): Free exam utilities — photo/signature resizers for exam forms, age calculators, percentage and CGPA calculators.
- [Blog](https://yespyq.com/blog/): Explainers on high-yield exam topics.
- [Guides](https://yespyq.com/guides/): Preparation strategy guides.

## About

- [About YESPYQ](https://yespyq.com/about/): What the site covers and how it is built.
- [PYQ Pass](https://yespyq.com/pyq-pass/): What the ₹149/year pass unlocks.
- [Contact](https://yespyq.com/contact/): teamyespyq@gmail.com

## Notes

- YESPYQ is not affiliated with UPSC, NTA, SSC, IBPS or any government body.
- Question text and all answer options are free on every page. Correct answers and explanations are free on roughly 10% of questions and gated behind PYQ Pass on the rest.
